_comment: Core damage-relevant mods. Values are per-rank increment; total = increment * (rank+1). Max value = increment * (maxRank+1).

_statTypes.DAMAGE: Base damage multiplier (Serration, Hornet Strike, etc)
_statTypes.FIRE_RATE: Fire rate multiplier (attack speed for melee)
_statTypes.HEAT: Heat elemental damage (additive with other elementals)
_statTypes.CONDITION_OVERLOAD: Damage per status type on target (melee)
_statTypes.GALV_STATUS_STACKS: Damage per status type on target (galvanized)
_statTypes.STATUS_DAMAGE: Damage of status effects / DoT ticks (Elementalist mods). Not applied by the engine yet
_statTypes.WEAK_POINT_DAMAGE: Weak point (headshot) damage bonus. Not applied automatically; engine takes weak_point_bonus
_statTypes.DAMAGE_FIRST_SHOT: Damage on the first shot of a magazine (Charged Chamber family). Not applied by the engine
_statTypes.RADIATION: Radiation elemental damage from a mod. Not applied by the engine yet
_statTypes.MAGNETIC: Magnetic elemental damage from a mod. Not applied by the engine yet
_statTypes.VIRAL: Viral elemental damage from a mod. Not applied by the engine yet
_statTypes.CRIT_CHANCE_PER_COMBO: Critical chance per melee combo multiplier (Blood Rush family)
_statTypes.STATUS_CHANCE_PER_COMBO: Status chance per melee combo multiplier (Weeping Wounds family)
_statTypes.CRIT_CHANCE_SLIDE: Critical chance on slide attacks (Maiming Strike)
_statTypes.SLASH_ON_CRIT: Chance for a critical hit to apply a Slash proc (Hunter Munitions)
_statTypes.*_WHILE_AIMING: Conditional: applies while aiming after the mod's trigger. Ignored by the engine
_statTypes.*_ON_KILL: Conditional: granted on kill, usually stacking. Ignored by the engine
_statTypes.*_ON_ABILITY: Conditional: granted on ability cast. Ignored by the engine
_statTypes.*_ON_RELOAD: Conditional: granted on reload. Ignored by the engine
_statTypes.*_ON_HEADSHOT: Conditional: granted on weak point hit. Ignored by the engine
_statTypes.*_ON_HIT: Conditional: granted on hit. Ignored by the engine
_statTypes.*_ON_EQUIP: Conditional: granted briefly on equip. Ignored by the engine
